tenders.title: RTCNS 49/26 Provision of Survey Services
tenders.agency: Department of Transport and Main Roads - RoadTek
tenders.summary: RoadTek Far North Queensland is looking to establish a single contract awarded to multiple suppliers for intermittent engagements during the term, who can provide survey services for construction works only. These services will be utilised on an as required basis for the nominated term.
